newsitem.title: SPAIN: BASKETBALL-AMERICAN PLAYER SACKED AFTER POSITIVE DOPE TEST.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-AMERICAN PLAYER SACKED AFTER POSITIVE DOPE TEST.

text.p: Spanish basketball side Pamesa Valencia have sacked American player Marquess Bragg after he tested postive for ephedrine in a routine drug test.
"It's impossible, I don't drink and I haven't taken any medication," said Bragg, who was playing for Pamesa on a temporary contract.
In the past several other Americans have tested positive for ephedrine, which is banned in Spain but is widely used in influenza remedies in the United States.
